versions.changelog:
Initial release of douyin-public-customer-acquisition

- Enables precision customer acquisition from Douyin public comment sections via data mining, supporting competitor interception, lead filtering, sentiment conversion, and private domain lead generation.
- Supports key scenarios: keyword lead search, competitor video comment mining, user pain point analysis, trending topic tracking, and structured lead export.
- Provides Node.js CLI tools for fast deployment without complex setup; requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for use.
- Includes ready-to-use examples for the most common customer acquisition workflows.
- Suitable for marketers and sales teams needing affordable, targeted Douyin lead generation and competitor traffic interception.
